title: Noun clauses
summary: Report facts with `-DIğI` and `-(y)AcAğI` as noun clauses (*Geleceğini biliyorum*), choose between `-mA` for actions and `-DIk` for facts, put questions inside sentences (*Nerede oturduğunu bilmiyorum*), pass on requests with *istemek* and *rica etmek*, and use whole clauses as subjects (*Gelmen önemli*).
canDo: Say what you know, heard, believe or doubt
Tell an order apart from a statement, and pass on requests politely
Say what you don't know or wonder: where, when, who, whether
Say that something is important, possible, true or clear
